claims: Eid al-Fitr 2026 is confirmed for Friday, March 20, 2026, in Saudi Arabia and several other countries.
The Shawwal crescent moon was not sighted on the evening of March 19.
Saudi Arabia confirmed that Eid al-Fitr will fall on Friday, March 20, 2026.
The Shawwal crescent was not visible on the evening of Thursday, March 19, in Saudi Arabia.
Qatar has confirmed they will follow the March 20 date.
The UAE has confirmed they will follow the March 20 date.
Kuwait has confirmed they will follow the March 20 date.
The 30-day fast concludes at sunset on Thursday, March 19.
The celebrations will begin with prayers on the morning of March 20, as stated in Gulf News and reported by The Sunday Guardian.
